Headline: #3 King Drive and # 66 Chicago buses Temporary Reroute near Fairbanks/Superior
ShortDescription: #3 King Drive and # 66 Chicago buses are temporarily rerouted in both directions, due to construction at Fairbanks/Superior.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
#3 King Drive and #66 Chicago buses are temporarily rerouted in both directions, due to construction at Fairbanks/Superior.

Southbound #3 King Drive buses will operate via Ontario, Michigan, and over regular route.

Northbound #3 King Drive buses will operate via Michigan, Ohio, Fairbanks, Erie and into the terminal.

Eastbound #66 Chicago buses will operate via Chicago, Michigan, Ohio, Fairbanks, Illinois and over regular route

Westbound #66 Chicago buses will operate via Grand, Fairbanks, Ontario, Michigan and over regular route.

 

Allow extra travel time.

Headline: #67 67th-69th-71st Temporary Reroute near 69th/Damen
ShortDescription: #67 67th-69th-71st buses temporarily rerouted in both directions, due to street blockage near 69th/Damen.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
#67 67th-69th-71st buses temporarily rerouted in both directions, due to street blockage near 69th/Damen.

Westbound buses will operate via 69th, Damen, Marquette, California, 71st, Western, and 69th then resume their normal route.

Eastbound buses will operate via Western, Marquette, Damen, and 69th then resume their normal route.

 

Allow extra travel time.
